title: Central position of histidine in the sequence of designed alternating polarity peptides enhances pH-responsive assembly with DNA.
authors: Taghizadeh Pirposhteh, Razieh; Mohajel, Nasir; Arashkia, Arash; Azadmanesh, Kayhan; Masoumi, Mohammadali
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过设计组氨酸位置不同的两亲性肽与DNA共组装，结合粗粒化分子动力学模拟探究pH响应性结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且含物理模拟方法，但对象为短肽而非典型转录因子，故评6分。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Self-assembling peptides hold great promise for medical applications, particularly as carriers for gene delivery, but their potential remains unrealized due to a limited understanding of how amino acid sequence positioning affects their properties. In this study, we designed and evaluated two alternating polarity peptides, RFH (RFRHRHRFR) and RHF (RHRFRFRHR), differing only in the position of their histidine and phenylalanine residues, to investigate the impact of sequence variation on pH-responsive DNA co-assembly and transfection efficiency. RESULTS: Both peptides formed stable co-assemblies with DNA at neutral pH. However, RHF retained its co-assembling ability at acidic pH, as confirmed by gel retardation studies. Coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations further supported these findings, showing a reduced affinity of RFH for DNA and a sharper decrease in DNA binding when its histidine residues were protonated. Morphological analysis revealed that both co-assemblies underwent structural transitions with increasing N/P ratios, though their sizes and morphologies differed significantly. Biological studies demonstrated that both peptides achieved a higher transfection efficiency in 293T and HeLa cells compared to R(9), with a lower cytotoxicity than polyethyleneimine. Notably, RFH exhibited superior transfection performance at lower N/P ratios compared to RHF, likely due to its distinct histidine and phenylalanine arrangement and its pH-responsive co-assembly behavior with DNA. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight the importance of histidine positioning within peptide sequences for tuning pH-responsiveness and optimizing DNA co-assembly and transfection efficiency. The results provide valuable insights for the rational design of efficient, safe, and pH-responsive peptide-based gene delivery systems.
abstract_zh: 背景：自组装肽在医学应用中具有巨大潜力，特别是作为基因递送的载体，但由于对氨基酸序列位置如何影响其性质的理解有限，其潜力尚未实现。在本研究中，我们设计并评估了两种交替极性肽，RFH（RFRHRHRFR）和RHF（RHRFRFRHR），它们仅在组氨酸和苯丙氨酸残基的位置上有所不同，以研究序列变异对pH响应性DNA共组装和转染效率的影响。结果：两种肽在中性pH下均与DNA形成稳定的共组装体。然而，RHF在酸性pH下保留了其共组装能力，这通过凝胶阻滞研究得到证实。粗粒化分子动力学 (coarse-grained molecular dynamics) 模拟进一步支持了这些发现，显示当RFH的组氨酸残基被质子化时，其对DNA的亲和力降低，且DNA结合能力急剧下降。形态学分析显示，随着N/P比增加，两种共组装体均发生结构转变，尽管它们的大小和形态存在显著差异。生物学研究表明，与R(9)相比，两种肽在293T和HeLa细胞中均实现了更高的转染效率，且细胞毒性低于聚乙烯亚胺 (polyethyleneimine)。值得注意的是，与RHF相比，RFH在较低N/P比下表现出更优的转染性能，这可能归因于其独特的组氨酸和苯丙氨酸排列及其与DNA的pH响应性共组装行为。结论：这些发现强调了肽序列中组氨酸位置在调节pH响应性和优化DNA共组装及转染效率方面的重要性。结果为合理设计高效、安全且pH响应性的基于肽的基因递送系统提供了宝贵见解。
